issues.description: resolvedSources path change from resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s) lacks a stated invariant or comment explaining why.
issues.detail: The one-line fix in DecodedMap silently changes the semantics of source resolution: previously 'from' was treated as a base directory; now it is treated as a file whose parent contains the sources. This is almost certainly correct (sourcemap 'sources' are relative to the map file, not its directory), but the invariant should be stated in a comment and ideally covered by a focused unit test on DecodedMap itself, not only the snapshot test.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside getSourceMap callback on every stack frame is asymptotically wasteful with no memoization.
issues.detail: parseErrorStacktrace invokes getSourceMap per frame; for a deep stack hitting the same external file repeatedly, the code does N existsSync+readFileSync+convertSourceMap.fromSource scans of the entire file. This is O(frames * fileSize) where O(uniqueFiles * fileSize) suffices. A small Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache keyed by file path would make the constants honest without changing correctness.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile scans entire file contents to find a trailing sourceMappingURL comment.
issues.detail: convert-source-map.fromSource regexes the whole code string. For large bundled external modules this is wasteful when the comment, by convention, lives in the final lines. Not worth optimizing without measurement (premature), but worth noting if profiling later shows stack-trace symbolication as hot. Leave as-is until measured.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the string '{}' for missing map files, silently masking errors.
issues.detail: Returning '{}' as a fallback 'empty source map' is clever but undocumented. A reader cannot tell whether this is a valid empty map per the spec or a hack to suppress throws inside convert-source-map. A literate comment naming the failure mode being suppressed (invalid filename in sourceMappingURL comment) and citing the upstream Vite precedent would make this auditable.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file invites subtle path-separator bugs on Windows.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' but the new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. pathe normalizes separators across platforms; node:path does not. On Windows the targetPath computed for sourceMappingURL resolution may differ from how the rest of Vitest normalizes paths. Prefer pathe consistently, or document why node:path is required here.

issues.description: Snapshot-only test coverage for the source-map fix; no direct unit test on DecodedMap.resolvedSources or extractSourcemapFromFile.
issues.detail: Correctness of the resolve(from, '..', s) change rests on the stacktraces snapshot, which proves the end-to-end behavior but not the invariant. A direct test of DecodedMap with a known sources array and known map URL would catch regressions if the resolution rule is ever 'optimized' again. Knuth's rule: tests complement proofs; here the proof (invariant) is also missing.

review.summary: The fix is plausibly correct and well-motivated: sourcemap 'sources' entries are relative to the map file's directory, so resolve(from, '..', s) replaces an earlier resolution that treated 'from' as a directory. However, the invariant is not stated anywhere in code or comment, and the only evidence of correctness is a snapshot diff. The new external-module source-map extraction in test-run.ts duplicates a Vite helper sensibly but reads files synchronously per stack frame with no memoization, mixes pathe with node:path, and uses an undocumented '{}' fallback. None of this is wrong; it is under-audited. Decision label: UNDER-AUDITED, leaning RIGOROUS once invariant and a small DecodedMap unit test are added.
